let f := fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))
let df := fun a => r * Real.exp (-(r * a))

have h_exp_deriv : HasDerivAt Real.exp (Real.exp x) x := Real.hasDerivAt_exp x
have h_linear_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun a => -(r * a)) (-r) x :=
  HasDerivAt.const_mul (by simp) (HasDerivAt.of_const r) x
have h_chain_rule : HasDerivAt f (df x) x :=
  HasDerivAt.exp h_linear_deriv (by rw [Real.exp, Real.exp]; exact h_exp_deriv)
exact h_chain_rule
